name: Hired Handaxe

abilities.name: Blood Frenzy
abilities.description: The handaxe has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

abilities.name: Battlefield Drift
abilities.description: The handaxe ignores difficult terrain, and opportunity attacks against it are made with disadvantage.

abilities.name: Fleet Agility
abilities.description: As a bonus action, the handaxe takes the Dash or Disengage action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The handaxe makes three attacks, using Handaxe or Shortsword.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage, and the handaxe has advantage on its next attack roll against the target before the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. Immediately after the attack, a handaxe returns to the handaxe's grasp, and the handaxe has advantage on its next attack roll against the target before the end of its next turn. Once on each of the handaxe's turns when it hits with this attack, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the handaxe's next turn.

actions.name: Axe Volley (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The handaxe hurls a handaxe at a point it can see within 90 feet. Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (9d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, the target is also knocked prone if it is Large or smaller.

generation.userConcept: a sellsword who hurls a handaxe and closes with a shortsword
